sample_unit: chest radiograph images (CheXpert training; CheXphoto perturbed test set)
models_evaluated: six ANNs for chest radiograph classification (architectures not named in the text)

links.outcome: Robust accuracy of chest radiograph classifiers on naturally and synthetically perturbed images (CheXphoto)
links.effect: Models produced by RoMIA show 3-5% improvement in robust accuracy on perturbed CheXphoto images, implying baseline models are brittle to input perturbations.
links.quote: Models produced by RoMIA show 3-5% improvement in robust accuracy, suggesting that the proposed methods can be a useful step towards enabling the adoption of ANNs in medical imaging applications.

unlisted_practices: Noise-added training to improve robustness of imaging models
Fine-tuning with input mixing using images from a different source
DCT-based denoising of images before classification

screen.reason: Evaluates RoMIA, which incorporates input preprocessing/denoising and robust training interventions to guard against clinical image perturbations and noise.
